name: Skygrid Courier
summary:
Taxi passengers across a cyberpunk cityscape with speed and precision!

Soar through neon-lit skies delivering passengers to their destinations as you pilot a taxi ship with speed and precision! Skygrid Courier is a physics-based action puzzler that requires you to manage the momentum of your craft to avoid obstacles and safely reach targets around single-screen cityscapes. Pick up passengers one at a time and fly to the landing pad of their color-coded destinations including clinics, clubs, hotels and labs.

Plan your route with quick-thinking strategy so you don’t run out of power for your ship and watch your shields! If you collide with objects or fly through hazards, a rough landing could cut your trip short! Choose from the task-based Mission mode to earn rewards, Arcade mode to race against the clock or Versus mode to compete in local multiplayer. Check your Hangar for unlockables as you progress, including alternate ships. Can you master the busy skyways of a neon-lit future, or will you crash and burn?
